title: Forever Bond

outfit_card.silhouette: Floor-length ceremonial robe featuring grand cascading bell-shaped tiers, layered flowing ribbons, architectural lotus shoulder pads, and a trailing voluminous train crowned by an oversized multi-tonal fox tail.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Plush white fox ears paired with ruby-enameled lotus hairpins, gold filigree hair sticks, and a dramatic cascading crystal pearl veil masking the lower face.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Ornate butterfly-shaped jeweled chest plate with cloisonné enamel, tied with royal blue sash ribbons over layered sheer organza sleeves that flare into petal-shaped drapery with gilded filigree borders.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multi-layered ombré pleated skirts flaring into wide lotus petal silhouettes, accented with embroidered swirling clouds, flowing tasseled sashes, delicate beaded fringes, and hidden embroidered silk platform slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A massive iridescent multi-hued fox tail, sharp gilded fingertip claws, floating glowing red lotus blossoms, and an ornamental pleated handheld folding fan.
